title: Fake News Detection: It’s All in the Data!

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review evaluating how collected fake news datasets may over-represent certain types of misinformation while under-representing others, leading to skewed model performance.
Literature review assessing how annotator preconceptions and inconsistent criteria in manual and crowdsourced labeling processes introduce biases into fake news ground-truth labels.

Literature review evaluating the limitations of fake news datasets that predominantly exist in a single language or specific cultural context, which restricts cross-lingual and global model generalizability.
